title: Lettered Continuation Pages (Print Only)

illustrates.quote: Lettered Continuation Pages. Material on a print page typically continues on one or more braille pages. Place the same print page number to end at the right margin on line 1 of each of these pages. Precede the page number by an unspaced a for the first continued page, b for the second, etc.

blocks.features: Four bordered page-outline thumbnails in a row, each a schematic mock-up (no body text): thumbnail 1 print page '45' / braille page 88; thumbnail 2 'a45' (continuation letter a) / braille page 89; thumbnail 3 'b45' (continuation letter b), with a dashed rule partway down leading to '46' (print page turns mid-braille-page) / braille page 90; thumbnail 4 'a46' (print page 46's own first continuation) / braille page 91.

print.notes: Explicitly '(Print Only)'; confirmed against the PDF page image (p.30): four small page-outline thumbnails, no braille cell rendering at all.

uncertain: The page numbers shown (45/88, a45/89, b45/90, a46/91) are schematic illustration numbers in the mock-up, not a real book's page numbers; preserved as shown.
resolution: Both runs agree: print-only, no braille (status: no-braille). Content recorded as a single 'other' block since Emboss's document model has no page-thumbnail/mock-up concept to build toward.
